description: This PHP test class 'EmployeeOnLeaveApiTest' extends 'EndpointIntegrationTestCase' and contains unit tests for the 'EmployeeOnLeaveAPI' class, including tests for 'getAll', and stub tests for 'create', 'delete', and their validation rules. It also includes a configuration setup method.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveApiTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeOnLeaveAPI endpoints, including retrieval of all employee leave records and ensuring unimplemented methods throw exceptions.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all employee leave records using the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetAll' by loading data from a YAML file.

methods.name: configEnablingPreHook
methods.description: Configures a specific setting in the database to enable a feature before tests.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the 'create' method of the API throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that getting validation rules for 'create' throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the 'delete' method of the API throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that getting validation rules for 'delete' throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.
